the fine structure of murine lung adenocarcinoma induced by treatment of the lung tissue with methylcholanthrene resembles, in some respects the fine structure of similarly induced adenomas and of spontaneous and in vivo induced murine lung tumors.

the ultrastructure of pulmonary adenocarinomata induced by 20-methylchoanthrene in vitro is similar to that of adenomata and lung tumours induced in vivo, and that ultrastructural differences between the three tumour types are related to the acquisition by the carcinomata of a malignant character.
